description: Terminal worker contract for the isolated child of trial e6-t18. Attenuated from K-E6-trial and within K-E6-child-max on every axis: no create primitive, no Bash, no children, no descendants, single model call.
protected_rules: No child may increase its authority envelope.
Model output is a proposal, never authorization.
The child is terminal: it may not create, delegate, or launch anything.
